crossRefs.note: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!
crossRefs.keyword: A.M. 3489. B.C. 515. Praise ye the Lord. Heb. Hallelujah

crossRefs.note: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!
Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!

translations.web: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.
translations.bsb: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.
translations.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
translations.asv: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise Jehovah, O my soul.
